structure QuantumState where
  re : Float
  im : Float
deriving DecidableEq, Repr, Inhabited, BEq

def QuantumState.zero : QuantumState := ⟨0.0, 0.0⟩

def QuantumState.one : QuantumState := ⟨1.0, 0.0⟩

def QuantumState.init (r i : Float) : QuantumState := ⟨r, i⟩

def QuantumState.magnitude (q : QuantumState) : Float :=
  Float.sqrt (q.re * q.re + q.im * q.im)

def QuantumState.magnitudeSquared (q : QuantumState) : Float :=
  q.re * q.re + q.im * q.im

def QuantumState.probability (q : QuantumState) : Float :=
  q.magnitudeSquared

def QuantumState.isFinite (q : QuantumState) : Bool :=
  q.re.isFinite && q.im.isFinite

def QuantumState.conjugate (q : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  ⟨q.re, -q.im⟩

def QuantumState.add (a b : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  ⟨a.re + b.re, a.im + b.im⟩

def QuantumState.sub (a b : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  ⟨a.re - b.re, a.im - b.im⟩

def QuantumState.mul (a b : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  ⟨a.re * b.re - a.im * b.im, a.re * b.im + a.im * b.re⟩

def QuantumState.scale (q : QuantumState) (s : Float) : QuantumState :=
  ⟨q.re * s, q.im * s⟩

def QuantumState.normalize (q : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  let m := q.magnitude
  if m > 0.0 && m.isFinite then ⟨q.re / m, q.im / m⟩
  else QuantumState.one

  fractalDepth : Nat

def Graph.empty : Graph :=

  , edges := Std.HashMap.empty
  , quantumRegister := Std.HashMap.empty
  , fractalDepth := 0

def Graph.removeNode (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) : Option Graph :=
  if !g.hasNode nodeId then none
  else
    let nodesAfter := g.nodes.erase nodeId
    let qrAfter := g.quantumRegister.erase nodeId
    let edgesToRemove := g.edges.fold (fun acc key _ =>
      if key.source == nodeId || key.target == nodeId then key :: acc
      else acc) []
    let edgesAfter := edgesToRemove.foldl (fun m k => m.erase k) g.edges
    let allocKeysAfter := g.allocatedNodeKeys.filter (· != nodeId)
    let allocEdgeKeysAfter := g.allocatedEdgeKeys.filter (fun k => k.source != nodeId && k.target != nodeId)
    some { g with
      nodes := nodesAfter
      , edges := edgesAfter
      , quantumRegister := qrAfter
      , allocatedNodeKeys := allocKeysAfter
      , allocatedEdgeKeys := allocEdgeKeysAfter
    }

    let newList := e :: existingList
    some { g with
      edges := g.edges.insert key newList
      , allocatedEdgeKeys := key :: g.allocatedEdgeKeys
    }

def Graph.removeEdge (g : Graph) (src tgt : String) : Option Graph :=

def Graph.updateNode (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) (f : Node → Node) : Option Graph :=

def Graph.updateEdge (g : Graph) (src tgt : String) (f : Edge → Edge) : Option Graph :=

  | none => none
  | some edgeList =>

structure Matrix2x2 where
  a00 : QuantumState
  a01 : QuantumState
  a10 : QuantumState
  a11 : QuantumState
deriving Repr, Inhabited, BEq

def Matrix2x2.identity : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.one
  , a01 := QuantumState.zero
  , a10 := QuantumState.zero
  , a11 := QuantumState.one
  }

def sqrtHalf : Float := 0.7071067811865476

def Matrix2x2.hadamard : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a01 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a10 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a11 := QuantumState.init (-sqrtHalf) 0.0
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliX : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.zero
  , a01 := QuantumState.one
  , a10 := QuantumState.one
  , a11 := QuantumState.zero
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliY : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.zero
  , a01 := QuantumState.init 0.0 (-1.0)
  , a10 := QuantumState.init 0.0 1.0
  , a11 := QuantumState.zero
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliZ : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.one
  , a01 := QuantumState.zero
  , a10 := QuantumState.zero
  , a11 := QuantumState.init (-1.0) 0.0
  }

def applyGate (gate : Matrix2x2) (state : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  let zeroAmp := QuantumState.init state.re 0.0
  let oneAmp := QuantumState.init state.im 0.0
  let newZero := QuantumState.add (QuantumState.mul gate.a00 zeroAmp) (QuantumState.mul gate.a01 oneAmp)
  let newOne := QuantumState.add (QuantumState.mul gate.a10 zeroAmp) (QuantumState.mul gate.a11 oneAmp)
  QuantumState.init newZero.re newOne.re

def Graph.applyQuantumGate (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) (gate : Matrix2x2) : Graph :=
  match g.getNode nodeId with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    let newState := applyGate gate n.quantumState
    let updatedNode := n.setQuantumState newState
    { g with
      nodes := g.nodes.insert nodeId updatedNode
      , quantumRegister := g.quantumRegister.insert nodeId newState
    }

def Graph.entangleNodes (g : Graph) (node1 node2 : String) : Option Graph :=
  if node1 == node2 then none
  else
    match g.getNode node1, g.getNode node2 with
    | some n1, some n2 =>
      let combined := QuantumState.mul n1.quantumState n2.quantumState
      let normalized := combined.normalize
      let g1 := { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert node1 (n1.setQuantumState normalized) }
      let g2 := { g1 with nodes := g1.nodes.insert node2 (n2.setQuantumState normalized) }
      let g3 := { g2 with quantumRegister := g2.quantumRegister.insert node1 normalized }
      let g4 := { g3 with quantumRegister := g3.quantumRegister.insert node2 normalized }
      some g4
    | _, _ => none

def PRNG.next (p : PRNG) : PRNG × UInt64 :=
  let s := p.state ^^^ (p.state >>> 12)
  let s := s ^^^ (s <<< 25)
  let s := s ^^^ (s >>> 27)
  let result := s * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D
  (⟨s⟩, result)

structure OptimizationStatistics where
  iterationsCompleted : Nat
  movesAccepted : Nat
  movesRejected : Nat
  bestEnergy : Float
  currentEnergy : Float
  temperature : Float
  acceptanceRate : Float
deriving Repr, Inhabited, BEq

def OptimizationStatistics.init : OptimizationStatistics :=
  { iterationsCompleted := 0
  , movesAccepted := 0
  , movesRejected := 0
  , bestEnergy := Float.inf
  , currentEnergy := Float.inf
  , temperature := 0.0
  , acceptanceRate := 0.0
  }

def OptimizationStatistics.updateAcceptanceRate (s : OptimizationStatistics) : OptimizationStatistics :=
  let total := s.movesAccepted + s.movesRejected
  let rate := if total > 0 then
    Float.ofNat s.movesAccepted / Float.ofNat total
  else 0.0
  { s with acceptanceRate := rate }

def OptimizationStatistics.incrementAccepted (s : OptimizationStatistics) : OptimizationStatistics :=
  let newAccepted := if s.movesAccepted < Nat.pred (2^63) then s.movesAccepted + 1 else s.movesAccepted
  { s with movesAccepted := newAccepted }

def OptimizationStatistics.incrementRejected (s : OptimizationStatistics) : OptimizationStatistics :=
  let newRejected := if s.movesRejected < Nat.pred (2^63) then s.movesRejected + 1 else s.movesRejected
  { s with movesRejected := newRejected }

structure Optimizer where
  temperature : Float
  coolingRate : Float
  maxIterations : Nat
  currentIteration : Nat
  minTemperature : Float
  initialTemperature : Float
  reheatThreshold : Float
  reheatFactor : Float
  adaptiveCooling : Bool
  prng : PRNG
  statistics : OptimizationStatistics
deriving Repr, Inhabited

def Optimizer.init (initialTemp coolingRateVal : Float) (maxIter : Nat) (seed : UInt64) : Optimizer :=
  let safeInitial := if initialTemp.isFinite && initialTemp > 0.0 then initialTemp else 1.0
  let safeCooling := if coolingRateVal.isFinite && coolingRateVal > 0.0 && coolingRateVal < 1.0 then coolingRateVal else 0.95
  let safeIters := if maxIter > 0 then maxIter else 1
  { temperature := safeInitial
  , coolingRate := safeCooling
  , maxIterations := safeIters
  , currentIteration := 0
  , minTemperature := DEFAULT_MIN_TEMP
  , initialTemperature := safeInitial
  , reheatThreshold := DEFAULT_REHEAT_THRESHOLD
  , reheatFactor := DEFAULT_REHEAT_FACTOR
  , adaptiveCooling := true
  , prng := PRNG.init seed
  , statistics := OptimizationStatistics.init
  }

def Optimizer.setMinTemperature (o : Optimizer) (minTemp : Float) : Optimizer :=
  if minTemp.isFinite && minTemp > 0.0 then { o with minTemperature := minTemp }
  else o

def Optimizer.setAdaptiveCooling (o : Optimizer) (enabled : Bool) : Optimizer :=
  { o with adaptiveCooling := enabled }

def Optimizer.setReheatParameters (o : Optimizer) (threshold factor : Float) : Optimizer :=
  let newThreshold := if threshold.isFinite && threshold > 0.0 then threshold else o.reheatThreshold
  let newFactor := if factor.isFinite && factor > 0.0 then factor else o.reheatFactor
  { o with reheatThreshold := newThreshold, reheatFactor := newFactor }

def computeEnergy (g : Graph) : Float :=
  let edgeEnergy := g.edges.fold (fun acc _ edgeList =>
    edgeList.foldl (fun e edge =>
      let we := if edge.weight.isFinite && edge.fractalDimension.isFinite then
        edge.weight * edge.fractalDimension
      else 0.0
      let me := edge.quantumCorrelation.magnitude
      let meVal := if me.isFinite then me else 0.0
      e + we + meVal
    ) acc
  ) 0.0
  let nodeEnergy := g.nodes.fold (fun acc _ node =>
    let m := node.quantumState.magnitude
    let mVal := if m.isFinite then m else 0.0
    acc + mVal
  ) 0.0
  edgeEnergy + nodeEnergy

def perturbEdge (e : Edge) (perturbation : Float) : Edge :=
  let newWeight := e.weight + perturbation
  let clampedWeight := Float.max 0.0 (Float.min 1.0 (if newWeight.isFinite then newWeight else e.weight))
  { e with weight := clampedWeight }

def perturbNode (n : Node) (realPert imagPert : Float) : Node :=
  let state := n.quantumState
  let newReal := state.re + realPert
  let newImag := state.im + imagPert
  if newReal.isFinite && newImag.isFinite then
    { n with quantumState := QuantumState.init newReal newImag }
  else n

def perturbGraph (g : Graph) (prng : PRNG) (temperature : Float) : Graph × PRNG :=
  let (edgesResult, prng1) := g.edges.fold (fun (acc, p) key edgeList =>
    let (newList, p') := edgeList.foldl (fun (lst, prngAcc) edge =>
      let (prng2, rv) := prngAcc.nextFloat
      if rv < PERTURBATION_EDGE_PROB then
        let (prng3, rv2) := prng2.nextFloat
        let pert := (rv2 - 0.5) * temperature * PERTURBATION_WEIGHT_SCALE
        (perturbEdge edge pert :: lst, prng3)
      else (edge :: lst, prng2)
    ) ([], p)
    (acc.insert key newList.reverse, p')
  ) (Std.HashMap.empty, prng)
  let (nodesResult, prng2) := g.nodes.fold (fun (acc, p) key node =>
    let (prng3, rv) := p.nextFloat
    if rv < PERTURBATION_NODE_PROB then
      let (prng4, rv2) := prng3.nextFloat
      let angle := rv2 * TWO_PI
      let realPert := temperature * PERTURBATION_STATE_SCALE * Float.cos angle
      let imagPert := temperature * PERTURBATION_STATE_SCALE * Float.sin angle
      (acc.insert key (perturbNode node realPert imagPert), prng4)
    else (acc.insert key node, prng3)
  ) (Std.HashMap.empty, prng1)
  ({ g with edges := edgesResult, nodes := nodesResult }, prng2)

def acceptMove (deltaEnergy temperature : Float) (prng : PRNG) : Bool × PRNG :=
  if !deltaEnergy.isFinite then (false, prng)
  else if deltaEnergy <= 0.0 then (true, prng)
  else if temperature <= 0.0 || temperature < 1e-12 then (false, prng)
  else
    let x := -deltaEnergy / temperature
    if x < EXP_UNDERFLOW_THRESHOLD then (false, prng)
    else
      let acceptanceProb := Float.exp x
      let (prng', rv) := prng.nextFloat
      (rv < acceptanceProb, prng')

def coolTemperature (o : Optimizer) : Optimizer :=
  let newTemp := if o.adaptiveCooling then
    let adjustedRate := if o.statistics.acceptanceRate > ACCEPTANCE_HIGH then
      o.coolingRate * 0.98
    else if o.statistics.acceptanceRate < ACCEPTANCE_LOW then
      o.coolingRate * 1.02
    else o.coolingRate
    let clampedRate := Float.max COOLING_RATE_MIN (Float.min COOLING_RATE_MAX adjustedRate)
    o.temperature * clampedRate
  else o.temperature * o.coolingRate
  let finalTemp := if newTemp < o.minTemperature then o.minTemperature else newTemp
  { o with temperature := finalTemp }

partial def optimizeLoop (o : Optimizer) (g : Graph) (currentEnergy bestEnergy : Float) (stagnationCounter : Nat) : Optimizer × Graph :=
  if o.currentIteration >= o.maxIterations then (o, g)
  else if o.temperature <= o.minTemperature then (o, g)
  else
    let candidate := g.clone
    let (perturbedCandidate, prng1) := perturbGraph candidate o.prng o.temperature
    let candidateEnergy := computeEnergy perturbedCandidate
    let deltaEnergy := candidateEnergy - currentEnergy
    let (shouldAccept, prng2) := acceptMove deltaEnergy o.temperature prng1
    let (newGraph, newCurrentEnergy, newBestEnergy, newStats, newStagnation) :=
      if shouldAccept then
        let acceptedStats := o.statistics.incrementAccepted
        let (updatedBest, resetStagnation) :=
          if candidateEnergy < bestEnergy then (candidateEnergy, 0)
          else (bestEnergy, stagnationCounter + 1)
        (perturbedCandidate, candidateEnergy, updatedBest, acceptedStats, resetStagnation)
      else
        let rejectedStats := o.statistics.incrementRejected
        (g, currentEnergy, bestEnergy, rejectedStats, stagnationCounter + 1)
    let updatedStats := { newStats with
      currentEnergy := newCurrentEnergy
      , bestEnergy := newBestEnergy
      , temperature := o.temperature
      , iterationsCompleted := o.currentIteration + 1
    }.updateAcceptanceRate
    let cooledOpt := coolTemperature { o with
      prng := prng2
      , statistics := updatedStats
      , currentIteration := o.currentIteration + 1
    }
    let stagnationLimit := Nat.max 1 (o.maxIterations / 10)
    let reheatedOpt := if newStagnation >= stagnationLimit then
      if cooledOpt.temperature < cooledOpt.initialTemperature * cooledOpt.reheatThreshold then
        { cooledOpt with temperature := Float.max cooledOpt.minTemperature (cooledOpt.temperature * cooledOpt.reheatFactor) }
      else cooledOpt
    else cooledOpt
    let finalStagnation := if newStagnation >= stagnationLimit && reheatedOpt.temperature > cooledOpt.temperature then 0 else newStagnation
    optimizeLoop reheatedOpt newGraph newCurrentEnergy newBestEnergy finalStagnation

def Optimizer.optimize (o : Optimizer) (g : Graph) : Optimizer × Graph :=
  let resetOpt := { o with
    statistics := OptimizationStatistics.init
    , temperature := o.initialTemperature
    , currentIteration := 0
  }
  let initEnergy := computeEnergy g
  let initStats := { resetOpt.statistics with
    bestEnergy := initEnergy
    , currentEnergy := initEnergy
    , temperature := resetOpt.temperature
  }

  if !g.hasNode nodeId then none
  else
    let nodesAfter := g.nodes.erase nodeId
    let qrAfter := g.quantumRegister.erase nodeId
    let edgesToRemove := g.edges.fold (fun acc key _ =>
      if key.source == nodeId || key.target == nodeId then key :: acc
      else acc) []
    let edgesAfter := edgesToRemove.foldl (fun m k => m.erase k) g.edges
    let allocKeysAfter := g.allocatedNodeKeys.filter (· != nodeId)
    let allocEdgeKeysAfter := g.allocatedEdgeKeys.filter (fun k => k.source != nodeId && k.target != nodeId)

      , quantumRegister := qrAfter

    let newList := e :: existingList
    some { g with
      edges := g.edges.insert key newList
      , allocatedEdgeKeys := key :: g.allocatedEdgeKeys
    }

  let key := EdgeKey.init src tgt
  if !g.hasEdge src tgt then none

    some { g with

  let key := EdgeKey.init src tgt
  match g.edges.get? key with
  | none => none
  | some edgeList =>
    if edgeList.isEmpty then none
    else

structure Matrix2x2 where
  a00 : QuantumState
  a01 : QuantumState
  a10 : QuantumState
  a11 : QuantumState
deriving Repr, Inhabited, BEq

def Matrix2x2.identity : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.one
  , a01 := QuantumState.zero
  , a10 := QuantumState.zero
  , a11 := QuantumState.one
  }

def sqrtHalf : Float := 0.7071067811865476

def Matrix2x2.hadamard : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a01 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a10 := QuantumState.init sqrtHalf 0.0
  , a11 := QuantumState.init (-sqrtHalf) 0.0
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliX : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.zero
  , a01 := QuantumState.one
  , a10 := QuantumState.one
  , a11 := QuantumState.zero
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliY : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.zero
  , a01 := QuantumState.init 0.0 (-1.0)
  , a10 := QuantumState.init 0.0 1.0
  , a11 := QuantumState.zero
  }

def Matrix2x2.pauliZ : Matrix2x2 :=
  { a00 := QuantumState.one
  , a01 := QuantumState.zero
  , a10 := QuantumState.zero
  , a11 := QuantumState.init (-1.0) 0.0
  }

def applyGate (gate : Matrix2x2) (state : QuantumState) : QuantumState :=
  let zeroAmp := QuantumState.init state.re 0.0
  let oneAmp := QuantumState.init state.im 0.0
  let newZero := QuantumState.add (QuantumState.mul gate.a00 zeroAmp) (QuantumState.mul gate.a01 oneAmp)
  let newOne := QuantumState.add (QuantumState.mul gate.a10 zeroAmp) (QuantumState.mul gate.a11 oneAmp)
  QuantumState.init newZero.re newOne.re

def Graph.applyQuantumGate (g : Graph) (nodeId : String) (gate : Matrix2x2) : Graph :=
  match g.getNode nodeId with
  | none => g
  | some n =>
    let newState := applyGate gate n.quantumState
    let updatedNode := n.setQuantumState newState
    { g with
      nodes := g.nodes.insert nodeId updatedNode
      , quantumRegister := g.quantumRegister.insert nodeId newState
    }

def Graph.entangleNodes (g : Graph) (node1 node2 : String) : Option Graph :=
  if node1 == node2 then none
  else
    match g.getNode node1, g.getNode node2 with
    | some n1, some n2 =>
      let combined := QuantumState.mul n1.quantumState n2.quantumState
      let normalized := combined.normalize
      let g1 := { g with nodes := g.nodes.insert node1 (n1.setQuantumState normalized) }
      let g2 := { g1 with nodes := g1.nodes.insert node2 (n2.setQuantumState normalized) }
      let g3 := { g2 with quantumRegister := g2.quantumRegister.insert node1 normalized }
      let g4 := { g3 with quantumRegister := g3.quantumRegister.insert node2 normalized }
      some g4
    | _, _ => none

def PRNG.next (p : PRNG) : PRNG × UInt64 :=
  let s := p.state ^^^ (p.state >>> 12)
  let s := s ^^^ (s <<< 25)
  let s := s ^^^ (s >>> 27)
  let result := s * 0x2545F4914F6CDD1D
  (⟨s⟩, result)

def PRNG.nextFloat (p : PRNG) : PRNG × Float :=
  let (p', v) := p.next

def Optimizer.init (initialTemp coolingRateVal : Float) (maxIter : Nat) (seed : UInt64) : Optimizer :=
  let safeInitial := if initialTemp.isFinite && initialTemp > 0.0 then initialTemp else 1.0
  let safeCooling := if coolingRateVal.isFinite && coolingRateVal > 0.0 && coolingRateVal < 1.0 then coolingRateVal else 0.95
  let safeIters := if maxIter > 0 then maxIter else 1
  { temperature := safeInitial
  , coolingRate := safeCooling
  , maxIterations := safeIters
  , currentIteration := 0
  , minTemperature := DEFAULT_MIN_TEMP
  , initialTemperature := safeInitial
  , reheatThreshold := DEFAULT_REHEAT_THRESHOLD
  , reheatFactor := DEFAULT_REHEAT_FACTOR
  , adaptiveCooling := true
  , prng := PRNG.init seed
  , statistics := OptimizationStatistics.init
  }

def Optimizer.setMinTemperature (o : Optimizer) (minTemp : Float) : Optimizer :=

  let newFactor := if factor.isFinite && factor > 0.0 then factor else o.reheatFactor
  { o with reheatThreshold := newThreshold, reheatFactor := newFactor }

def computeEnergy (g : Graph) : Float :=
  let edgeEnergy := g.edges.fold (fun acc _ edgeList =>
    edgeList.foldl (fun e edge =>
      let we := if edge.weight.isFinite && edge.fractalDimension.isFinite then
        edge.weight * edge.fractalDimension
      else 0.0
      let me := edge.quantumCorrelation.magnitude
      let meVal := if me.isFinite then me else 0.0
      e + we + meVal
    ) acc
  ) 0.0
  let nodeEnergy := g.nodes.fold (fun acc _ node =>
    let m := node.quantumState.magnitude
    let mVal := if m.isFinite then m else 0.0
    acc + mVal
  ) 0.0
  edgeEnergy + nodeEnergy

def perturbEdge (e : Edge) (perturbation : Float) : Edge :=
  let newWeight := e.weight + perturbation
  let clampedWeight := Float.max 0.0 (Float.min 1.0 (if newWeight.isFinite then newWeight else e.weight))
  { e with weight := clampedWeight }

def perturbNode (n : Node) (realPert imagPert : Float) : Node :=
  let state := n.quantumState
  let newReal := state.re + realPert
  let newImag := state.im + imagPert
  if newReal.isFinite && newImag.isFinite then
    { n with quantumState := QuantumState.init newReal newImag }
  else n

def perturbGraph (g : Graph) (prng : PRNG) (temperature : Float) : Graph × PRNG :=
  let (edgesResult, prng1) := g.edges.fold (fun (acc, p) key edgeList =>
    let (newList, p') := edgeList.foldl (fun (lst, prngAcc) edge =>
      let (prng2, rv) := prngAcc.nextFloat
      if rv < PERTURBATION_EDGE_PROB then
        let (prng3, rv2) := prng2.nextFloat
        let pert := (rv2 - 0.5) * temperature * PERTURBATION_WEIGHT_SCALE
        (perturbEdge edge pert :: lst, prng3)
      else (edge :: lst, prng2)
    ) ([], p)
    (acc.insert key newList.reverse, p')
  ) (Std.HashMap.empty, prng)
  let (nodesResult, prng2) := g.nodes.fold (fun (acc, p) key node =>
    let (prng3, rv) := p.nextFloat
    if rv < PERTURBATION_NODE_PROB then
      let (prng4, rv2) := prng3.nextFloat
      let angle := rv2 * TWO_PI
      let realPert := temperature * PERTURBATION_STATE_SCALE * Float.cos angle
      let imagPert := temperature * PERTURBATION_STATE_SCALE * Float.sin angle
      (acc.insert key (perturbNode node realPert imagPert), prng4)
    else (acc.insert key node, prng3)
  ) (Std.HashMap.empty, prng1)
  ({ g with edges := edgesResult, nodes := nodesResult }, prng2)

def acceptMove (deltaEnergy temperature : Float) (prng : PRNG) : Bool × PRNG :=
  if !deltaEnergy.isFinite then (false, prng)
  else if deltaEnergy <= 0.0 then (true, prng)
  else if temperature <= 0.0 || temperature < 1e-12 then (false, prng)
  else
    let x := -deltaEnergy / temperature
    if x < EXP_UNDERFLOW_THRESHOLD then (false, prng)
    else
      let acceptanceProb := Float.exp x
      let (prng', rv) := prng.nextFloat
      (rv < acceptanceProb, prng')

def coolTemperature (o : Optimizer) : Optimizer :=
  let newTemp := if o.adaptiveCooling then
    let adjustedRate := if o.statistics.acceptanceRate > ACCEPTANCE_HIGH then
      o.coolingRate * 0.98
    else if o.statistics.acceptanceRate < ACCEPTANCE_LOW then
      o.coolingRate * 1.02
    else o.coolingRate
    let clampedRate := Float.max COOLING_RATE_MIN (Float.min COOLING_RATE_MAX adjustedRate)
    o.temperature * clampedRate
  else o.temperature * o.coolingRate
  let finalTemp := if newTemp < o.minTemperature then o.minTemperature else newTemp
  { o with temperature := finalTemp }

partial def optimizeLoop (o : Optimizer) (g : Graph) (currentEnergy bestEnergy : Float) (stagnationCounter : Nat) : Optimizer × Graph :=
  if o.currentIteration >= o.maxIterations then (o, g)
  else if o.temperature <= o.minTemperature then (o, g)
  else
    let candidate := g.clone
    let (perturbedCandidate, prng1) := perturbGraph candidate o.prng o.temperature
    let candidateEnergy := computeEnergy perturbedCandidate
    let deltaEnergy := candidateEnergy - currentEnergy
    let (shouldAccept, prng2) := acceptMove deltaEnergy o.temperature prng1
    let (newGraph, newCurrentEnergy, newBestEnergy, newStats, newStagnation) :=
      if shouldAccept then
        let acceptedStats := o.statistics.incrementAccepted
        let (updatedBest, resetStagnation) :=
          if candidateEnergy < bestEnergy then (candidateEnergy, 0)
          else (bestEnergy, stagnationCounter + 1)
        (perturbedCandidate, candidateEnergy, updatedBest, acceptedStats, resetStagnation)
      else
        let rejectedStats := o.statistics.incrementRejected
        (g, currentEnergy, bestEnergy, rejectedStats, stagnationCounter + 1)
    let updatedStats := { newStats with
      currentEnergy := newCurrentEnergy
      , bestEnergy := newBestEnergy
      , temperature := o.temperature
      , iterationsCompleted := o.currentIteration + 1
    }.updateAcceptanceRate
    let cooledOpt := coolTemperature { o with
      prng := prng2
      , statistics := updatedStats
      , currentIteration := o.currentIteration + 1
    }
    let stagnationLimit := Nat.max 1 (o.maxIterations / 10)
    let reheatedOpt := if newStagnation >= stagnationLimit then
      if cooledOpt.temperature < cooledOpt.initialTemperature * cooledOpt.reheatThreshold then
        { cooledOpt with temperature := Float.max cooledOpt.minTemperature (cooledOpt.temperature * cooledOpt.reheatFactor) }
      else cooledOpt
    else cooledOpt
    let finalStagnation := if newStagnation >= stagnationLimit && reheatedOpt.temperature > cooledOpt.temperature then 0 else newStagnation
    optimizeLoop reheatedOpt newGraph newCurrentEnergy newBestEnergy finalStagnation

def Optimizer.optimize (o : Optimizer) (g : Graph) : Optimizer × Graph :=
  let resetOpt := { o with
    statistics := OptimizationStatistics.init
    , temperature := o.initialTemperature
    , currentIteration := 0
  }
  let initEnergy := computeEnergy g
  let initStats := { resetOpt.statistics with
    bestEnergy := initEnergy
    , currentEnergy := initEnergy
    , temperature := resetOpt.temperature
  }
  let preparedOpt := { resetOpt with statistics := initStats }
  optimizeLoop preparedOpt g initEnergy initEnergy 0

def Graph.calculateFractalDimension (g : Graph) : Float :=
  let totalWeight := g.edges.fold (fun acc _ edgeList =>
    edgeList.foldl (fun e edge =>
      if edge.fractalDimension.isFinite then e + edge.fractalDimension
      else e
    ) acc
  ) 0.0
  let edgeCount := g.edgeCount
  if edgeCount > 0 then
    let avg := totalWeight / Float.ofNat edgeCount
    if avg.isFinite && avg >= 0.0 then avg else 0.0
  else 0.0

  bytes.foldl (fun acc b =>

    acc ++ String.singleton (hexChars.get! ⟨hi⟩) ++ String.singleton (hexChars.get! ⟨lo⟩)

    some (newGraph, probVal)
